race.description: Ray White | Barossa Valley Two Wells Hcp (C1)
race.comment: MAYSOONFLY (6) has impressed in two runs back from a spell, the latest offering a close second over 1200m at this track after she was in the firing line all the way. Won't mind the step back in distance and she should be right at her peak at this stage of the campaign. SUPER CHOICE (1) has held his own in a couple of Saturday metro races since returning from a spell, the best run coming two back when beaten under a length over this distance at Morphettville. Draws the fence and will be tough to stop when presented. KAYLA KRUZEN (4) returned from a spell with a tidy all-the-way win in a maiden over this course and distance 12 days ago. Has always shown ability and might be ready to go to a new level this prep. JASSTAR (5) looked a bit flat on a seven-day back-up at Murray Bridge last start. Better placed over the extra 100m off a 26-day freshen.
